notes: Gzip-9 measurements cover each Web-facing entry. Caps move only with an explicit rationale; standalone provider graphs include the shared Effect core and are reported, not capped.
The root cap covers the Effect core, routing, bounded transport, OAuth coordination, request ownership and validation.
./json-schema keeps schema validation and rendering available through an optional entry.
./auth/clerk includes the Clerk SDK and native auth orchestration.
./auth/cloudflare-access keeps Workers identity at the optional boundary.
./ui covers the operator contract, native composition and embedded browser asset manifest.
./credentials contains the encrypted credential vault outside the root graph.
./d1 includes native Effect SQL execution and atomic batches with statement change metadata.
./activity contains payload-free activity history and its optional routes.
examples/worker covers the combined deployment graph, native routing and authenticated body bounds; measure the actual combined artifact.
./auth/access-tokens contains managed agent token records and their operator lifecycle.
./worker owns bounded admission and request-owned loader/RPC disposal around the optional DynamicWorkerExecutor.
operator-ui/assets caps the generated browser assets by summed gzip payload size and raw bytes.
./google contains the optional service-account signer and token cache; the root excludes it.
